excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, a robotic duck only 25 centimeters tall unexpectedly thrust the imagination of edge AI into the spotlight. Microduck, released by Pollen Robotics under Hugging Face, is an open-source bipedal robot priced at $399. Weighing about 800 grams, it can walk, sit, kick a ball, and grasp objects out of the box, and it can even get back up on its own after falling. More importantly, it is not just a toy that moves—it is an open-source robotics platform for developers: users can train action policies in a simulated environment and then deploy them onto the real robot. This "little duck" has drawn attention not only because it is cute enough and cheap enough, nor simply because robots are finally making their way onto ordinary developers' desktops. The real signal it sends is this: AI is moving from models inside screens to physical devices that can perceive, act, and interact. Over the past few years, when people talked about AI, the conversation usually centered on cloud-based large models, parameter scale, training clusters, and compute centers. But when AI begins to enter the real world, the questions become very concrete: Can devices respond locally? Can they operate offline? Can private data stay off the cloud? Can power consumption and heat dissipation be acceptable to end devices? Can costs support large-scale adoption? These are exactly the questions that must be answered for edge AI to truly take root. excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, un pato robótico de solo 25 centímetros de alto ha puesto inesperadamente el foco sobre la imaginación de la IA en el edge. Pesa unos 800 gramos y, nada más sacarlo de la caja, puede caminar, sentarse, patear una pelota, agarrar objetos e incluso levantarse por sí solo tras una caída. Más importante aún, no es solo un juguete que se mueve, sino una plataforma robótica de código abierto pensada para desarrolladores: los usuarios pueden entrenar estrategias de movimiento en entornos simulados y luego desplegarlas en el robot real. items.title: 上线物业缴费专属入口，支付宝以数字化助力物业行业服务力长效落地
items.raw_excerpt: 今日，克而瑞服务力发布大会举办，支付宝智能物业相关代表登台并发表主题演讲。支付宝物业服务凭借成熟的数字化解决方案成功入选《克而瑞2026中国物业服务力红皮书》，意味着其在智慧社区领域的实践成果获得行业认可。 值得关注的是，支付宝生活缴费同步上线物业缴费专属入口，正式将物业服务接入这一亿级民生窗口。依托18年民生服务运营积累，支付宝打造"服务+缴费"一体化入口，业主办理日常民生业务时即可完成物业费查缴，而对物业合作伙伴来说，配合平台消息推送，形成"触达—转化—沉淀"的完整运营链路。截至目前，已有近5000个小区入驻支付宝生活缴费平台。 为支撑服务长效落地，支付宝以产品、AI、运营三大能力重构物业服务流程。AI对话缴费将多步操作简化为语音指令，支持账单查询、经用户授权后的自动代扣签约，降低业主操作门槛。另外，平台配套缴费优惠、签到活动等运营工具，持续激发缴费意愿。支付宝表示，数智化能力正成为物业提升服务效率的重要支撑。通过便捷缴费、账单提醒、自动代扣及配套运营工具，部分合作小区的业主主动缴费意愿有所提升，物业催缴和收费运营效率也得到改善。 未来，支付宝将持续深耕社区服务赛道，以数字化底座赋能物业合作伙伴，推动行业由规模扩张转向品质运营，实现业主满意度与企业经营效益的双向提升。 雷峰网 雷峰网
